name: Let the Land Take It Back

description.value:
Frequency once per week

Requirement The target has a Scar you can work on.

Spend a day of downtime working a Scar the way you'd work a ruin back into the ground — not repairing it, unmaking it. Choose one Scar the target carries and remove it entirely: its Slot returns to fully open, with no Gift, no Tithe, and no Minor mutation left in its place. This trades nothing for anything — it's ground with nothing built on it at all.
